resources.string:
App rules apply only to the selected profile. Use this list for complete apps; website and in-app rules have their own screens.

Choose a mode:
• Block selected: Selected apps are blocked. Other apps stay available unless a limit blocks them.
• Allow selected: Selected apps stay available. Other apps shown in this list are blocked. Apps not shown here stay available.

Available apps:
• The list contains installed apps with a regular launcher entry.
• Removed apps can remain marked as Unavailable until you remove them.
• Protected system apps are skipped by Select all and require a separate risk confirmation.

Automatically block new apps is available in Block selected mode and adds newly installed launchable apps to this profile.
This profile is in Allow selected mode, but no apps are selected. Listed picker apps may be blocked, but apps not shown in the picker are treated as allowed.
